authorization: User authorized implementation after planning, excluding the deferred whole-catalog scientific audit. Expected work may span interruptions; checkpoint source and research artifacts locally.

phases.name: Taxonomy and database candidates
requirements: Keep 10 large and 25 small categories.
Keep separate small Structural graph theory and Graph algorithms; merge differential privacy into large Cryptography (already implemented).
Merge Automated reasoning into the large category Logic, verification and automated reasoning; retain large Automata and formal languages and small Database theory.
Move general finite-model theory into logic. Research genuinely database-specific candidates, including CONCUR/KDD and database venues.
Split Algebraic computation into small Algebraic algorithms and Algebraic complexity.
Rename Beyond worst-case and average-case analysis to Average-case analysis. Retain smoothed/planted/random-input models; move non-average-case targets elsewhere.

phases.name: Inputs and archive
requirements: Snapshot current votes and rank order. Community notes already archived separately, outside publication.
Inspect archived resolved cards; restore candidates open at the start of 2026 whose first public solution appeared on or after 2026-01-01. Preserve historical scientific evidence and uncertainty.
Streaming Euclidean MST proposal is already TCS-7376; do not duplicate.

phases.name: Diverse Miscellaneous candidates
requirements: Add broadly TCS-relevant problems from diverse fields beyond the suggested sunflower, Shannon-capacity/theta and partial-order examples.
Avoid duplicates and validate each new question against primary sources.

phases.name: Whole-catalog scientific and numerical audit
requirements: Do not run now. Remind the user AFTER the green cards are finalized.
Eventually check aggregators/OpenAI results and search the web for each card; verify the exact model and original resolution date.
Eventually check numerical targets including polynomial exponents at additive accuracy 0.01. TCS-0154 was corrected before deferral and remains corrected.

phases.name: Initial green/red selection
requirements: Assign every active card green or red; target 25 in every large category and 10 in every small category (500 total if filled).
Use current importance order and topic diversity. The square-root-of-cluster-size example is intuition, not a numerical rule.
Any upvote is a strong preference for green, regardless of downvotes. Explain each upvoted red card individually.
Negative votes and solvedness alone do not imply rejection. Keep general Exact Matching rather than its bipartite special case.
Allow a deficit rather than selecting weak filler.

phases.name: Balance and paired category moves
requirements: Default is the current category, with modest moves allowed when they improve balance in the strength of selected cards.
For selected suitable cards define exactly two allowed categories, one large and one small.
Provide an up/down category action preserving the card's green/red state.

phases.name: Shared review interface
requirements: Persist shared color and category choices on the existing service; editing for the user's group, public read-only visibility.
Allow manual red/green changes without enforcing quotas.
Show actual green count / target per category in the left panel and the total.
Provide All / Green / Red filters.
Retain notes outside the final public reader.

phases.name: Validate and publish
requirements: Test taxonomy, selection completeness, upvoted-red explanations, UI and durable shared writes including concurrent edits.
Preserve existing notes, proposals, votes and unrelated source changes.
Use the current live source; do not deploy the older dirty /home/vasek/atlas checkout.
Publish the completed review version using the existing GitHub Pages site and Sites backend.

excluded_additions: No mandatory rationale on every green/red card; only upvoted-red exceptions are required.
reminder: Once the user finalizes the green cards, remind them to perform deferred phase 4; initial AI proposals alone do not trigger it.

checkpoints.summary: Taxonomy remains 10 large/25 small. Restored 14 post-cutoff solved cards and developed archived TCS-0495. Added two database and nine Miscellaneous cards. Moved TCS-6380 to Database theory and TCS-6610 to Miscellaneous. Selection and shared UI remain pending.
checkpoints.validation: make check passed after updating solved-card eligibility, ranking and related links.
